name: claudefuscator
description: Claudefuscator: replaces incidental identifiers with stable tokens before they reach Anthropic, and restores them locally.

plugins.name: claudefuscator
plugins.description: Mod mode. Rewrites the typed prompt, project instructions, tool descriptions, tool calls and rendered output. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: claudefuscator-hooks
plugins.description: Hooks-only mode, for versions without mod support. Covers tool output; cannot rewrite a typed prompt.
